articles.summary: In a new article for Route Fifty, NextNav's Deepak Joseph explores why America needs a reliable GPS complement and backup, and how California is helping lead the way. The world's first ground-based, 5G-powered 3D positioning, navigation and timing (PNT) network is currently being tested in Santa Clara County, demonstrating the potential of complementary technology to strengthen America's PNT resilience.
articles.title: Route Fifty: America needs a GPS backup, and California leads the way

articles.summary: NextNav CEO and CTIA Board Member Mariam Sorond joined CTIA’s Wireless Spotlight to discuss why America needs a resilient, ground-based complement and backup to GPS and what’s at stake without one.
articles.title: CTIA Wireless Spotlight: Talking with Mariam Sorond
